description: Dividing zero by zero is an evaluation error rather than a number
notes: The spec says arithmetic operators always produce numbers and that the number type has no NaN value, which can't both hold for 0 / 0, and it never says division can fail. hashicorp/hcl reports an error: DivideFunc in cty/function/stdlib/number.go recovers the big.ErrNaN panic from math/big and returns an error, which BinaryOpExpr.Value in hclsyntax/expression_ops.go reports as "Operation failed".
